title: Quenched Velvety Croatian Lentils Stew
description: This earthy and velvety stew features French lentils and is a show-off Croatian dish, perfect for special occasions, and is diabetic-friendly
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the French lentils, tomato paste, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Use an ice bath to stop the cooking process and shock the lentils.
Let the stew cool to room temperature, then refrigerate it overnight.
Reheat the stew over low heat, stirring occasionally, until warmed through.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
